title: Recording, mixing: Live And Let Die by Wings | 1972
content:
Studio One, AIR Studios, London
Producer: George Martin
Engineer: Bill Price

Wings finished recording ‘Live And Let Die’ on 21 October 1972.

The song had been recorded in three takes on 20 October. It was edited and some overdubs were added the following day.

The overdubs included additional lead vocals, electric piano, and backing vocals by the whole band. Once they were complete, the song was mixed into stereo by studio engineer Bill Price. ‘Live And Let Die’ was mastered at EMI Studios on Abbey Road on 23 October.
